metrics.matching_rule: Class- and score-blind maximum-cardinality matching at IoU>=0.5, then maximum summed IoU over all positive-area post-NMS proposals. Native zero-area subthreshold rows are preserved separately and cannot match annotations or become copper alarms.
metrics.scope: Frame-object annotation diagnostics on exposed or development recordings; not independent holdouts, unique physical pieces, chemistry or physical sorting.

display_filter: Native copper-class detections at or above each frozen copper threshold only. No class relabeling. Full post-NMS proposals, including steel detections, retained privately for scoring.
display_note: Display JPEGs use OpenCV JPEG quality60 at unchanged native dimensions, encoded directly from the exact decoded viewing-video pixels used for inference. Display compression occurs after inference; boxes and scores are unchanged.
label_verification_note: 843 frames retain individual image-content comparison. 136 additional sampled frames use audited publisher frame ordinals and original/converted label hashes with recording-level content support; individual publisher image-pixel comparison was not performed for those additions.
